note: City of Rockford park beside the Shell Rock River at the north edge of town: angled gravel pads around a loop, with open lawn running from the loop road down to the river; playground and disc golf. Pay cash in the envelope at the info sign. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $15-20, FCFS no reservations, showers. Sites 31 (14 full hookup + 17 electric/water), water + sewer added. Riverview confirmed (loop road between pads and the open bank). Season only 'as fair weather permits'.
flags: WATERFRONT riverview confirmed: the Shell Rock here is ~35-50 m wide on Esri imagery (river-sized). The pads sit inside the campground loop; the loop road runs between them and an open lawn that reaches the north and east bank 55-60 m away, so on-water is ruled out by the loop-road rule but the river is in open view from the outer pads.
